Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ ذَاقَ حَلاَوَةَ مَحَبَّتِكَ فَرَامَ مِنْكَ بَدَلًا
Translation: My Lord, who has tasted the sweetness of Your love and then sought a substitute for You?

Arabic text: وَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ أَنِسَ بِقُرْبِكَ فَابْتَغَىٰ عَنْكَ حِوَلًا
Translation: And who has felt the comfort of Your nearness and then sought an alternative to You?

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ فَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنِ اصْطَفَيْتَهُ لِقُرْبِكَ وَوِلايَتِكَ
Translation: My Lord, make us among those whom You have chosen for Your nearness and Your friendship
And purified for Your affection and Your love
And made eager for meeting You
And made pleased with Your decree
And granted the vision of Your face
And blessed with Your pleasure
And protected from Your abandonment and aversion
And settled in the seat of truth in Your presence
And distinguished with Your recognition
And qualified for Your worship
And made their hearts devoted to Your will
And chosen for witnessing You
And dedicated their faces to You alone
And emptied their hearts for Your love
And made them desire what is with You
And inspired them with Your remembrance
And granted them thankfulness to You
And occupied them with Your obedience
And made them among the righteous of Your creation
And chosen them for intimate conversation with You

Arabic text: وَقَطَعْتَ عَنْهُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ يَقْطَعُهُ عَنْكَ
Translation: And cut off from them everything that separates them from You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ دَأْبُهُمُ الْإِرْتِيَاحُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْحَنِيْنُ
Translation: O Allah, make us among those whose habit is to find comfort in You and to yearn for You
And whose life is filled with sighs and lamentation
Whose foreheads prostrate to Your greatness
And whose eyes stay awake in Your service
And whose tears flow from fear of You
And whose hearts are attached to Your love
And whose souls are overwhelmed by Your majesty

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ أَنْوَارُ قُدْسِهِ لِأَبْصَارِ مُحِبِّيْهِ رَائِقَةٌ
Translation: O You whose holy lights are appealing to the eyes of those who love You
And the glory of whose face causes longing in the hearts of those who know You
O desire of the hearts of the yearning ones
And O ultimate goal of the hopes of those who love You
I ask You for Your love and the love of those who love You

Arabic text: وَحُبَّ كُلِّ عَمَلٍ يُوصِلُنِيْ إِلٰى قُرْبِكَ
Translation: And the love of every deed that brings me closer to You

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا سِوَاكَ
Translation: And that You make Yourself more beloved to me than anything else

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَ حُبِّيْ إِيَّاكَ قَائِدًا إِلَى رِضْوَانِكَ
Translation: And that You make my love for You a guide to Your pleasure
And my longing for You a barrier against disobeying You
And bestow upon me the vision of You
And look upon me with the eye of affection and kindness
And do not turn Your face away from me

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْاِسْعَادِ وَالْحُظْوَةِ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: And make me among the people of happiness and favor with You
O Answerer of prayers, O Most Merciful of the merciful
